title: At the Dolphin they halted to allow the ambulance car to gallop past them for Jervis street.
html_source: “Dolphin” refers to the Dolphin Hotel on Essex Street, a famous hotel & restaurant, now used as office space for the Dublin courts service. “Jervis Street” refers to a main hospital, the site of which has been taken over by a shopping centre
